title: School Transportation Checklist
subtitle: Capture route number, stop location, rider roster, and mobility support; confirm driver handoff and arrival reconciliation.
description: School Transportation records route number, stop location, rider roster, mobility support, driver handoff, and arrival reconciliation. School Transportation evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this school transportation stage-gated verification when staff must document route number and stop location. Reconcile rider roster, mobility support, driver handoff, and arrival reconciliation before the school transportation handoff. Use the route sheet, stop map, rider roster, accessibility assignment, driver manifest, guardian transfer record, delay notice, scan or headcount, and arrival exception. Ask the assigned school transportation reviewer to confirm route number against the organization's policy.

sections.title: School Transportation contact and reference
sections.guidance: Match rider to route, stop and schedule; record mobility support, driver roster, guardian transfer, bus exception, arrival confirmation, and missed-stop response.

sections.title: School Transportation checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current school transportation facts at point of use.

blocks.label: School Transportation required checks
items: Route number is identified for this record
Stop location matches the current request or source
Rider roster is ready for point-of-use staff
Mobility support limits or questions are resolved
Driver handoff is communicated to the responsible person
Arrival reconciliation is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: School Transportation failed or pending items

sections.title: School Transportation readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold school transportation readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: School Transportation reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: School Transportation receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
